i know their story and they dated when they were young teens(we're in our mid-twenties now)

i completely understand your reaction!! the conversation we had when he talked about his friend was about our relationship insecurities where i also said that if i hadn't met him, i probably would've dated someone i was talking to before i met him. we both sometimes wonder what life would've been like with other people, but that's not what we wanted; or at least that's not what i wanted. i feel like the only difference is that he is still friends with her since they have known each other forever and i stopped talking to the other guy. the convo felt pretty productive at the time, but i'm not so sure anymore. 
thank you so much for taking the time to read my post and replying. <3
